title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude Code background agents now use Haiku 5.5 for progress updates (Nov 5)
bullets.summary: Background agents have Haiku 5.5 write progress updates from short notes, cutting per-update cost by about 99%, and Anthropic says sessions with background agents may use about 5% less of a user's allowance (per The Neuron roundup; not checked against Anthropic's own notes).
bullets.how: The Construct: scheduled routines and background agents should burn less allowance with no config change; worth watching usage after the update. PRAGMA: concrete cost-control example for client agent deployments. Brand 9 Signs: indirect.

bullets.title: OpenAI reports an autonomous pipeline that built working Linux kernel privilege-escalation exploits for 948 vulnerabilities (Nov 5)
bullets.summary: OpenAI says its pipeline flagged 2,308 potential kernel flaws, reproduced 1,724 and built working local privilege-escalation exploits for 948 distinct vulnerabilities for about $1.21M in API credits; maintainers had already patched 61 upstream with 43 more in preparation (per The Neuron; I did not read OpenAI's post).
bullets.how: PRAGMA: strong evidence that automated offensive security is cheap now, supporting an agent-tooling and endpoint hardening audit offer. The Construct: reinforces keeping the Mac runner patched and scoped. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Meta acquires multi-agent coding orchestrator Conductor; cloud service sunsets Nov 13-20 (Nov 4-5)
bullets.summary: New sign-ups ended Nov 4, Conductor Cloud goes read-only Nov 13 with data deletion from Nov 20, and local Conductor gets updates until early 2027 (per Conductor's announcement as relayed by the aggregators).
bullets.how: The Construct: only matters if any agent workflow depends on Conductor Cloud; otherwise a reminder not to build on single-vendor orchestration layers. PRAGMA: vendor-lock-in risk talking point for clients.

bullets.title: Notion ships shared memory so ChatGPT, Claude and other assistants use the same workspace context (Nov 5)
bullets.summary: Notion's shared agent memory lets multiple assistants read the same workspace context (per The Neuron roundup; no Notion primary source read).
bullets.how: The Construct: a possible neutral shared-memory layer across Claude and other agents if Notion is already in use. PRAGMA: a pattern for client multi-assistant setups. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: New community image/video/3D MCP tooling: Muse4AI bridge and Scenario agent skills trending on GitHub (Nov 3-5)
bullets.summary: Muse4AI (created Nov 3) is a local Windows bridge exposing image and video generation to agents via REST, MCP and OAuth, and Scenario's skills repo teaches coding agents to produce content through the Scenario MCP server; both are community repos reported by an aggregator, unaudited.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs / The Construct: possible additions for signage mockup and marketing image/video generation, but vet code and permissions before installing given the recent plugin-tampering reports. PRAGMA: none yet.

praxis_lesson: Agent cost and lock-in are now design inputs: Anthropic is routing low-value work like progress updates to a cheaper model while orchestration vendors get acquired and shut down on a two-week clock, so route cheap work to cheap models and keep every workflow portable across orchestrators. (Caveats: all items come from aggregator roundups, not primary sources; no verified signage, CRM or DAM MCP news and no arXiv items confirmed today, so those categories are omitted.)
